title: Big Wins, Small Net Gains: Direct and Spillover Effects of First Industry Entries in Puerto Rico
abstract: arXiv:2511.19469v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I study how first sizable industry entries reshape local and neighboring labor markets in Puerto Rico. Using over a decade of quarterly municipality--industry data (2014Q1--2025Q1), I identify ``first sizable entries'' as large, persistent jumps in establishments, covered employment, and wage bill, and treat these as shocks to local industry presence at the municipio--industry level. Methodologically, I combine staggered-adoption difference-in-differences estimators that are robust to heterogeneous treatment timing with an imputation-based event-study approach, and I use a doubly robust difference-in-differences framework that explicitly allows for interference through pre-specified exposure mappings on a contiguity graph. The estimates show large and persistent direct gains in covered employment and wage bill in the treated municipality--industry cells over 0--16 quarters. translated_title: 大赢小得：波多黎各首次行业进入的直接效应与溢出效应
translated_abstract: 本文研究了首次大规模行业进入如何重塑波多黎各本地及邻近劳动力市场。利用超过十年的季度市镇-行业数据（2014Q1–2025Q1），作者将“首次大规模进入”识别为机构数量、覆盖就业和工资总额出现的大幅且持续的跳跃，并将其视为市镇-行业层面对本地行业存在的冲击。在方法论上，本文将稳健于异质性处理时点的交错采用双重差分估计量与基于插补的事件研究方法相结合，并使用双重稳健的双重差分框架，通过在邻接图上预先设定的暴露映射显式地允许干扰（溢出）效应。估计结果显示，在受处理的市镇-行业单元中，处理后0–16个季度内覆盖就业和工资总额出现了巨大且持久的直接收益；同行业邻近地区也经历了可观的短期收益……
tldr: 本文结合稳健交错双重差分与允许溢出干扰的双重稳健DID框架，发现波多黎各首次大规模行业进入为本地就业和工资带来巨大且持久的直接收益，但同行业邻近地区的短期收益使得总体净收益较小。
en_tdlr: Combining robust staggered-adoption difference-in-differences with a doubly robust DID framework that allows for spillover interference, this paper shows that first sizable industry entries in Puerto Rico generate large and persistent direct gains in local employment and wage bills, while short-run gains to same-industry neighbors imply small net gains overall.
